run_model_free_ptq: run model_free_ptq on MiniMax-M2.7 with W4A16 quantization scheme and FP8BlockDequantizer pre-processing
create_quantization_scheme: create a QuantizationScheme targeting attention and MoE projection layers with W4A16 configuration
apply_fp8_block_dequantizer: apply FP8BlockDequantizer to dequantize FP8_BLOCK layers before W4A16 quantization
configure_quantization_targets: configure regex targets for self_attn projections, MoE expert weights, and gate_up_proj layers
